#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate an ICS calendar file for the team meeting next Wednesday at 3 PM (1 hour)."""
from datetime import datetime, date, timedelta, timezone
import uuid

# --- Determine "next Wednesday" (Wednesday = weekday 2) ---
# Use the first Wednesday strictly after today, so the event is in the future.
today = date.today()
days_ahead = (2 - today.weekday()) % 7
if days_ahead == 0:
    days_ahead = 7  # today is Wednesday -> next Wednesday is a week out
meeting_date = today + timedelta(days=days_ahead)

# --- Event details ---
# Default timezone assumption: America/New_York (Eastern Time).
# The user can ask to change this if another timezone applies.
TZ_NAME = "America/New_York"
SUMMARY = "Team Meeting"
DTSTART = datetime(meeting_date.year, meeting_date.month, meeting_date.day, 15, 0)  # 3 PM
DTEND = datetime(meeting_date.year, meeting_date.month, meeting_date.day, 16, 0)    # 4 PM (1 hour)
UID = f"{uuid.uuid4()}@calendar"
DTSTAMP = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")

# --- Build ICS content (RFC 5545) ---
def fmt_local(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")

ics = "\r\n".join([
    "BEGIN:VCALENDAR",
    "VERSION:2.0",
    "PRODID:-//Calendar Skill//Team Meeting//EN",
    "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "METHOD:PUBLISH",
    "BEGIN:VEVENT",
    f"UID:{UID}",
    f"DTSTAMP:{DTSTAMP}",
    f"SUMMARY:{SUMMARY}",
    f"DTSTART;TZID={TZ_NAME}:{fmt_local(DTSTART)}",
    f"DTEND;TZID={TZ_NAME}:{fmt_local(DTEND)}",
    "STATUS:CONFIRMED",
    "TRANSP:OPAQUE",
    "SEQUENCE:0",
    "BEGIN:VALARM",
    "ACTION:DISPLAY",
    "DESCRIPTION:Team Meeting starts in 15 minutes",
    "TRIGGER:-PT15M",
    "END:VALARM",
    "END:VEVENT",
    "END:VCALENDAR",
    "",
])

out_path = "team_meeting.ics"
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
    f.write(ics)

print(f"Created: {out_path}")
print(f"Summary : {SUMMARY}")
print(f"Date    : {meeting_date.isoformat()} ({meeting_date.strftime('%A')})")
print(f"Start   : {DTSTART.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')} {TZ_NAME}")
print(f"End     : {DTEND.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')} {TZ_NAME}")
print(f"UID     : {UID}")
